en_US.rules.ludo: Ludo for 2–4 players. Four pawns each; pawn 1 starts on the track. Six deploys a pawn or moves it six spaces and grants another roll. Land on rivals to send them to their yard. Captured pawns need six to return. No blocking, color jumps, rebound or triple-six penalty. Finish all four pawns with exact rolls to win.
en_US.table.ludo.hint: Roll the die · Point at a highlighted pawn · Click to move
en_US.hint.ludo.stack: {count} pawns → {destination} · {effect} · Click to choose a pawn
en_US.rules.gomoku: 15×15 freestyle Gomoku. First to connect five or more stones wins. Black has no forbidden moves.
en_US.rules.xiangqi: Xiangqi: facing generals, blocked horse legs and elephant eyes, river and palace limits, and checks are enforced. Checkmate or stalemate loses. See the rules panel for repetition and perpetual check.
en_US.rules.chess: Chess: castling, en passant, four promotion choices, checkmate, stalemate, repetition, and the 50-move draw are supported.
en_US.rules.aeroplane: Aeroplane Chess: roll six to launch, jump or fly on matching colors, and stack planes as blockades. A third consecutive six sends unfinished planes home. This server variant applies.
en_US.rules.checkers: Chinese Checkers on a 121-hole star for 2, 3, 4, or 6 players. Step to adjacent holes or make chained short jumps. Move all pieces into the opposite camp to win.
en_US.rules.draughts: 8×8 English draughts: Black moves first. Men move and capture forward; kings can make short jumps both ways. Captures and continued captures with the same piece are mandatory. Crowning ends the turn. Threefold repetition or 40 moves each without a capture or man move is an automatic draw.
en_US.rules.reversi: 8×8 Reversi: Black moves first. Bracket enemy discs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to flip them. A player without a legal move passes automatically. When neither player can move, the player with more discs wins.
en_US.rules.go: Go supports 9×9, 13×13, and 19×19 boards. Area scoring with 7.5 komi for White, no suicide, and positional superko. After two passes, mark dead groups and have both players confirm the score; either player may resume play to resolve a dispute. Bots make basic moves only.
en_US.rules.yacht: Yacht dice for 2–4 players. Each player has 12 rounds and up to three rolls per turn. Hold any dice, score each category once, and optionally score zero. Small straight is 15, large straight 30, Yacht 50, and reaching 63 in the upper section adds 35. There is no extra Yacht bonus. Click dice to hold them and use the menu to fill the score sheet.
en_US.rules.connectfour: Connect Four on a vertical 7×6 board. Click a column to drop a piece. Four in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins; a full board without a winner is a draw.
en_US.rules.default: Choose a game to view its rules.

zh_CN.rules.ludo: 2–4 人，每人 4 枚棋子；开局首枚自动出营。6 点可以出营或前进，并再掷一次。落到对手位置将其送回营地，被送回的棋子需要 6 点重新出营。不阻挡通行、无同色跳跃、无回弹、无连续三个 6 惩罚。精确到达终点，四枚全部完成者获胜。

zh_CN.rules.gomoku: 15×15自由五子棋，先连成五子或更多获胜；不设黑方禁手。
zh_CN.rules.xiangqi: 中国象棋：将帅照面、马腿、象眼、象不过河、九宫及自将过滤。将死或困毙判负；重复和长将规则以规则面板标注为准。
zh_CN.rules.chess: 国际象棋：王车易位、吃过路兵、四种升变、将死与逼和，含重复与50回合和棋判定。
zh_CN.rules.aeroplane: 飞行棋：6点起飞，同色跳跃/飞越，叠机壁垒；连续第三个6使未完成飞机回营。以此服务器变体为准。
zh_CN.rules.checkers: 121孔六角星中国跳棋，支持2/3/4/6人；相邻步行或连续短跳，把全部棋子送入对面营地获胜。
zh_CN.rules.draughts: 8×8 英美式西洋跳棋：黑先，兵只向前走及吃子，王可双向短跳；有吃必吃，连吃必须用同一棋子，升王立即结束该回合。三次同局面或双方各40步无吃子、无兵移动自动和棋。
zh_CN.rules.reversi: 8×8 黑白棋：黑先，横竖斜线夹住对方棋子并全部翻面；无合法落点自动停手，双方都无法落子时，多子者获胜。
zh_CN.rules.go: 围棋有9/13/19路。面积计分、白贴7.5目，禁自杀和全局同形。双方连续停手后进入死子协商：点击棋块切换标记，双方确认后结算；任何一方都可恢复行棋解决争议。陪练只会基础落子，不具备职业判断。
zh_CN.rules.yacht: 2–4人快艇骰子，每人12轮，每回合最多掷3次，可保留任意骰子；每种计分项只填一次，可主动填零。小顺15、大顺30、快艇50，上半区达到63分额外加35分；没有额外快艇奖励。点击桌上骰子可保留，操作菜单填写计分表。
zh_CN.rules.connectfour: 7列6行竖直四子棋；点击列后重力落子，横、竖、双斜向四连获胜；满盘无赢家则和局。

You may draw once and then play any legal card or pass. First empty hand wins before resolving its last card effect. No stacking or declaration penalty.
